prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 8 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: APARTMENT CORRIDOR, Night, warm interior corridor light.
Image 1: the character sheet of 林青羽 (21), look S2
Image 2: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S3
Image 3: the character sheet of 路少泽 (28), look S1
Image 4: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 5: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 8: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 9: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 10: the prop grocery bag full of greens; use only structure, material, and color
Image 11: the prop black handbag; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu stand side by side on the runner rug with their backs to Ji Ran's apartment door, his right arm around her waist and the grocery bag full of greens in his left hand; Ji Ran has the black handbag on her shoulder. Lu Shaoze stands on the runner rug one step in front of them, facing Ji Ran's apartment door, pointing angrily at Lin Qingyu. The camera stays on the side of the cream wall opposite Ji Ran's apartment door.
Panel 1: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, two-shot of Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu in front of her door. Ji Ran folds her arms and rolls her eyes at Lu Shaoze, while Lin Qingyu keeps his arm around her waist.
Panel 2: Close-up, slow push in on Ji Ran, eye-level. Ji Ran leans her head toward Lin Qingyu's shoulder and gives Lu Shaoze a cool, steady look.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, handheld, eye-level, over Ji Ran's shoulder onto Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze's eyes widen, and he takes a sharp step forward on the runner rug.
Panel 4: Medium shot, low angle, handheld, on Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze throws both hands out in disbelief.
Panel 5: Close-up, quick push in on Lu Shaoze's face, eye-level. Lu Shaoze smirks smugly at Ji Ran and taps his own chest.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran with Lin Qingyu at her shoulder. Ji Ran lifts her chin, and Lin Qingyu bites back a grin beside her.
Panel 7: Close-up, slight low angle, locked-off camera, on Ji Ran. Ji Ran raises one eyebrow at Lu Shaoze in open challenge.
Panel 8: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze's mouth falls open, and his hands freeze halfway in the air.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
